rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a pharmacist as a qualified medicines professional.

example.english: I’ll ask the pharmacist whether this medicine can be taken with cold medicine.
example.traditional: 我去問下藥劑師，呢隻藥可唔可以同感冒藥一齊食。
